evidence: mytime.de lists Toppits Backpapier (8 m) at €2.29 and Jeden Tag Backpapier Rolle (20 m x 38 cm) at €1.89, read on 6 Nov 2026, with VAT and plus shipping. Six Jeden Tag rolls at the page's 6-or-more price are €10.26.
differences: Toppits states FSC paper and use up to 220 C. Jeden Tag's page doesn't state a top temperature, so check the box before baking hot. We did not read a Toppits width. No test covers this pair.
why: Both are rolls of baking paper at the same store, and the Jeden Tag roll is longer for less money.
